title: Help General
statementMd:
Once upon a time in the Kingdom of Far Far Away lived Sir Lancelot, the chief Royal General. He was very proud of his men and he liked to invite the King to come and watch drill exercises which demonstrated the fighting techniques and tactics of the squad he was in charge of. But time went by and one day Sir Lancelot had a major argument with the Fairy Godmother (there were rumors that the argument occurred after the general spoke badly of the Godmother's flying techniques. That seemed to hurt the Fairy Godmother very deeply).

As the result of the argument, the Godmother put a rather strange curse upon the general. It sounded all complicated and quite harmless: "If the squared distance between some two soldiers equals to $5$, then those soldiers will conflict with each other!"

The drill exercises are held on a rectangular $*n* × *m*$ field, split into $*nm*$ square $1 × 1$ segments for each soldier. Thus, the square of the distance between the soldiers that stand on squares $(*x*_{1}, *y*_{1})$ and $(*x*_{2}, *y*_{2})$ equals exactly $(*x*_{1} - *x*_{2})^{2} + (*y*_{1} - *y*_{2})^{2}$. Now not all $*nm*$ squad soldiers can participate in the drill exercises as it was before the Fairy Godmother's curse. Unless, of course, the general wants the soldiers to fight with each other or even worse... For example, if he puts a soldier in the square $(2, 2)$, then he cannot put soldiers in the squares $(1, 4)$, $(3, 4)$, $(4, 1)$ and $(4, 3)$ — each of them will conflict with the soldier in the square $(2, 2)$.

Your task is to help the general. You are given the size of the drill exercise field. You are asked to calculate the maximum number of soldiers that can be simultaneously positioned on this field, so that no two soldiers fall under the Fairy Godmother's curse.

## Input

The single line contains space-separated integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 1000$) that represent the size of the drill exercise field.

## Output

Print the desired maximum number of warriors.

## Note

In the first sample test Sir Lancelot can place his 4 soldiers on the $2 × 4$ court as follows (the soldiers' locations are marked with gray circles on the scheme):

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5949c8ef04ce69ae3d19123922f262416fac4f5c.png)

In the second sample test he can place 6 soldiers on the $3 × 4$ site in the following manner:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/14f409a1ceb3cc04a1b6f42bbb218b6be0f92a05.png)
statementZhMd:
从前，在遥远王国中，兰斯洛特爵士是皇家军队的首席将军。他为自己的士兵们感到非常自豪，并喜欢邀请国王前来观看操练，以展示由他所率领小队的战斗技术与战术。但时光流逝，终于有一天，兰斯洛特爵士与仙女教母发生了激烈争执（有传言说，争执发生在将军说了仙女教母飞行技术的坏话之后。这似乎深深地伤害了仙女教母）。

争执的结果是，仙女教母对将军施加了一个相当奇怪的诅咒。诅咒听起来复杂，却似乎毫无危害：“如果任意两名士兵之间的距离平方等于 $5$，那么这两名士兵就会发生冲突！”

操练在一个矩形的 $*n* × *m*$ 场地上进行，该场地被划分为 $*nm*$ 个 $1 × 1$ 的方格，每个方格供一名士兵站立。因此，站在方格 $(*x*_{1}, *y*_{1})$ 和 $(*x*_{2}, *y*_{2})$ 上的两名士兵之间的距离平方恰好等于 $(*x*_{1} - *x*_{2})^{2} + (*y*_{1} - *y*_{2})^{2}$。由于仙女教母的诅咒，现在不能像以前一样让全部 $*nm*$ 名士兵参加操练。当然，除非将军希望士兵们互相争斗，甚至发生更糟糕的事情……例如，如果他在方格 $(2, 2)$ 中安排一名士兵，那么就不能在方格 $(1, 4)$、$(3, 4)$、$(4, 1)$ 和 $(4, 3)$ 中安排士兵——这些士兵中的每一名都会与 $(2, 2)$ 方格中的士兵发生冲突。

你的任务是帮助这位将军。给定操练场地的大小，请计算在没有任意两名士兵触发仙女教母诅咒的情况下，最多可以同时在场地上安排多少名士兵。

## 输入格式

一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 1000$），表示操练场地的大小。

## 输出格式

输出所需的最大士兵数。

## 说明

在第一个样例测试中，兰斯洛特爵士可以按如下方式在 $2 × 4$ 的场地上安排 4 名士兵（图中用灰色圆圈标出了士兵的位置）：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5949c8ef04ce69ae3d19123922f262416fac4f5c.png)

在第二个样例测试中，他可以按如下方式在 $3 × 4$ 的场地上安排 6 名士兵：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/14f409a1ceb3cc04a1b6f42bbb218b6be0f92a05.png)
